The wait setting and the label gate A batch takes a text file only once its labels are in: suggested, confirmed, or the file’s own tags. A file still being labeled, or whose suggestion failed, stays in the queue with a Next batch pill and goes in a later batch. A failed suggestion is retried by itself up to 3 times; after that the row waits for you (Retry, + Add, or Send without labels). Files the AI can’t label (PDFs, images) and every file when queue labeling is off go in as before. Wait before picking up a file is set in hours and minutes, 0 (no wait) to 24 hours.
